title: UPS
description: UPSs monitored through NUT in Home Assistant, scraped from Home Assistant's Prometheus endpoint. Layout follows grafana.com dashboard 25293 (UPS Monitor, RFC 1628 UPS-MIB).

panels.title: Location
panels.description: Home Assistant area the UPS is assigned to.

targets.expr: max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_battery_percent{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_battery_charge", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

panels.title: Rated Power
panels.description: Nominal real power (W) the UPS reports; load power is load % of this.

targets.expr: max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_power_w{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_nominal_real_power", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_nominal_battery_voltage", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

panels.title: NUT Data
panels.description: Whether Home Assistant is receiving this UPS's sensors from NUT. Unavailable means HA lost the NUT server or the UPS, so every other panel is stale. The UPS's own status (online / on battery) is a text sensor, which Home Assistant's Prometheus export doesn't include.

targets.expr: min by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_entity_available{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_.*", entity!~".*_alarms|.*_transfer_reason", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_battery_percent{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_battery_charge", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

panels.title: Estimated Runtime
panels.description: Runtime at the current load, as estimated by the UPS.

targets.expr: max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_duration_s{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_battery_runtime", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_battery_voltage", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

panels.title: Battery vs Nominal
panels.description: Battery voltage as a % of nominal. A healthy lead-acid pack floats around 110-115% on mains, and falls toward ~87% as it runs flat.

targets.expr: max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_battery_voltage", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*")) / max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_nominal_battery_voltage", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*")) * 100

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_unit_percent{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_load", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_unit_percent{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_load", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*")) / 100 * max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_power_w{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_nominal_real_power", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_input_voltage", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_output_voltage", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_unit_percent{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_load", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_duration_s{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_battery_runtime", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

panels.title: Input & Output Voltage
panels.description: Dashed grey is nominal input voltage (120 V if the UPS doesn't report it), red dashes are +/-10%, and orange is the UPS's high-voltage transfer point, where it switches to battery.

targets.expr: max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_input_voltage", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_output_voltage", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

max(max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_nominal_input_voltage", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))) or vector(120)

(max(max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_nominal_input_voltage", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))) or vector(120)) * 1.1

(max(max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_nominal_input_voltage", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))) or vector(120)) * 0.9

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_high_voltage_transfer", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_battery_percent{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_battery_charge", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

panels.title: Battery Voltage
panels.description: Dashed grey is the nominal pack voltage.

targets.expr: max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_battery_voltage", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_voltage_v{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_nominal_battery_voltage", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

panels.title: Load Power
panels.description: Load % x rated power. Dashed grey is the rated power.

targets.expr: max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_unit_percent{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_load", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*")) / 100 * max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_power_w{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_nominal_real_power", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))

max by (ups, area) (label_replace(bwood_sensor_power_w{job="home-assistant", entity=~"sensor\\..*ups_nominal_real_power", friendly_name=~"$ups .+"} * on (entity) group_left (area) bwood_entity_info{area=~"$location"}, "ups", "$1", "friendly_name", "(?i)(.*?ups) .*"))
